payout_quote: Malvern Bank is providing a Welcome Bonus of $300.00 (to be paid on day 91 of the account) if the account meets two requirements. 1. The account is funded with money not previously held at Malvern Bank. 2. The account remains open for 90 days and meets each of the Monthly Requirements for each of the statement cycles.
steps: Open a new Malvern Bank Premier Checking account online (personal checking; fund with money not previously held at Malvern Bank).

For each of the first three statement cycles: (1) receive at least one direct deposit, (2) make at least 10 PIN or signature-based debit card transactions, (3) access online banking at least once, (4) remain enrolled for e-statements.
Keep the account open; the $300 Welcome Bonus is paid on day 91 of the account.
catches: No bonus payout until day 91 — and only if you meet all four Monthly Requirements in EVERY statement cycle: (1) at least one direct deposit per cycle, (2) at least 10 PIN/signature debit card transactions per cycle, (3) access online banking at least once per cycle, (4) remain enrolled for e-statements.
Funded with money not previously held at Malvern Bank (current Malvern checking customers may still qualify by opening Premier Checking with at least $1,000 of new money).
Aggregator copies describe this as a 'limited time offer' but no expiration date is stated on the official page — confirm the offer is still advertised before applying.
Iowa-based bank; check online-opening eligibility for your state before applying.
Bonuses are considered interest and will be reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
biggest_catch: Bonus isn't paid until day 91, and you must meet ALL four monthly requirements (direct deposit, 10 debit card transactions, online banking login, e-statements) in EACH of the first three statement cycles — miss one and the bonus is gone.
eligibility: Open a new Premier Checking account (personal checking can be opened online); funded with new money not previously held at Malvern Bank. Current Malvern checking customers qualify by opening Premier Checking with at least $1,000 of new money. Account must remain open 90 days.
timing: Paid on day 91 of the account; account must remain open 90 days and meet monthly requirements each cycle.
